G3 fails — no specific currently-unpriced figure was identified; WVE-006's MZ-like phenotype data (64% M-AAT, 71% Z-AAT reduction) is already public and re-rated.
verified.edge: M — the events are company-guided and widely covered by sell-side, so the calendar itself is not proprietary; residual edge is that the WVE-006 accelerated-approval decision is a genuine step-function (a surrogate-endpoint path in AATD would be a first) and the exact FDA answer is unknowable from the tape. Not differentiated information, only differentiated conviction on an unpriced regulatory branch.
verified.primary_source: Wave Life Sciences Q1 2026 results/business update, 2026-04-28 (ir.wavelifesciences.com / GlobeNewswire) and "Plans to Accelerate Regulatory Engagement with Full Control of WVE-006", 2026-02-02; INLIGHT Phase 2a multidose initiation reported 2026-06-24 (StockTitan aggregation of WVE 8-K).
verified.analysis: All three flagged legs verify as real, forward, and unfired: Wave reaffirmed the WVE-N531 NDA filing for 2026 with the FDA confirming the dystrophin accelerated-approval surrogate remains open, guided FDA feedback on a WVE-006 accelerated-approval path for mid-2026 after regaining full rights from GSK (2026-02-02), and initiated the INLIGHT Phase 2a multidose obesity portion on 2026-06-24. The weakness is date precision — "2026" and "mid-2026" are guidance windows, not PDUFA or a scheduled data day, so the milestone cannot be sized to a specific week, and the WVE-006 window is arguably already open, raising slip risk into 2H. Gap in verification: I could not retrieve the June/July 8-K primary text (SEC.gov returned 403) to confirm no post-Q1 guidance change, so the timing rests on Q1-2026 and May-2026 company statements plus a secondary aggregator; that plus failed G3 caps this at WATCH rather than ACTIVE.

verified.edge: L — the buyout schedule, 2026 guidance ($1.75-1.95B EBITDA, $600-700M FCFBG) and the 2.1GW-through-2030 repowering plan were all laid out at the Feb 10, 2026 Q4 call and are in consensus; the stock has already re-rated +42%, and management explicitly declined to commit to buybacks or restarting distributions "over the next five years," removing the single event that would force a re-rate.
verified.primary_source: XPLR Infrastructure Q4 2025 earnings call, Feb 10, 2026 (via Investing.com/GuruFocus transcript highlights) + Q4 2025 8-K exhibit 99, filed Feb 2026; CEPF 5 partial-buyout sizing from Q4 2025 call coverage.
verified.analysis: There is a genuine dated, forward, sized deleveraging step — the first partial CEPF 5 call in H2 2026 at roughly $150M, followed by ~$470M in 2027 and the CEPF 3 call/asset-sale decision in 2027 — so this clears the "real and datable" bar but only barely. The problem is edge: every one of these figures came from the company's own February 2026 guidance, the milestone is a routine self-funded capital-structure step rather than a discrete surprise, and with the units already up 42% the deleveraging narrative is at least partly in the price. Critically, the terminal catalyst (distribution restart) has been explicitly disowned for five years, so the equity has no dated event that converts deleveraging into a payout — it is a slow grind, not a catalyst trade. Gap: I could not confirm from the primary 8-K/10-Q (SEC fetch 403'd) whether a precise calendar date for the CEPF 5 call has been disclosed; the H2-2026 timing is from Q4-call reporting.

verified.edge: M — the IgG4-RD approval leg is largely priced after INDIGO hit (HR 0.44, p=0.0005) and is high-probability, so limited upside there; the real edge is the Q4 2026 SLE Phase 2, an undiscounted two-sided binary in a large indication on a ~$1.9B cap with $719M cash (runway to 2029), which caps downside but also means a miss does not threaten solvency.
verified.primary_source: Zenas BioPharma PR, "Announces Submission of BLA to U.S. FDA for Obexelimab in IgG4-RD," 2026-05-28 (GlobeNewswire/investors.zenasbio.com); plus Q1 2026 Financial Results & Corporate Update, 2026-05-13 (SEC 8-K Ex-99.1) for the Q4 2026 SLE topline guidance, $718.55M cash and the $75M+$75M approval-contingent financing.
verified.kill_fact: Financing leg is inert, not a catalyst: Zenas held $718.5M cash at 2026-03-31 with runway guided "at least through Q2 2029" — and that guidance ALREADY factors in both the $75M Royalty Pharma approval milestone and the $75M Pharmakon approval tranche (Q1 2026 corporate update, 2026-05-13). The $150M is ~20% of cash on hand at a company funded three years out and is in management's own base case, so it moves nothing. Separately, the line understates fired content: the actual de-risking event was the positive Phase 3 INDIGO readout in Jan 2026 (56% flare-risk reduction, HR 0.44, p=0.0005), which is priced and already triggered the first RP milestone, making IgG4-RD approval near-consensus. Facts that DO hold: BLA submitted 2026-05-28 (confirmed, company PR); SunStone Ph2 SLE fully enrolled, topline guided Q4 2026 (confirmed); both $75M amounts and their FDA-approval triggers confirmed exactly; no FDA acceptance/PDUFA announcement found as of 2026-07-20, with the ~60-day filing decision due ~late July, so that leg is genuinely forward. Unflagged risk: the SLE topline already slipped once from mid-2026 to Q4 2026, and it is a Phase 2 in an indication with a long failure history — it is the only real unpriced binary, and it carries both slip and base-rate risk.
verified.analysis: Verified: BLA submitted 2026-05-28 for obexelimab in IgG4-RD (company PR/GlobeNewswire), with EMA MAA guided H2 2026 and Phase 2 SunStone SLE fully enrolled with topline guided Q4 2026 (Q1 2026 corporate update, 2026-05-13). Both remaining legs are forward, dated and unfired; the filing itself is the only fired component, and the FDA acceptance/PDUFA assignment (~60 days from submission, so due imminently) has not been announced as of 2026-07-20 — that is the near-term catalyst. Not a macro bet: outcomes are drug-specific and the $150M approval-contingent capital from Royalty Pharma/Pharmakon is a concrete, mechanically-triggered figure. Gap in verification: I could not confirm from the investor-relations page (fetch timed out) whether an acceptance/priority-review press release landed in the last few days, so treat the PDUFA date as unassigned-but-imminent rather than confirmed absent.

verified.catalyst: FDA PDUFA decision Aug 25, 2026 on Jazz's sBLA for Ziihera (zanidatamab) in 1L HER2+ gastroesophageal adenocarcinoma, which contractually triggers a $250M cash milestone from Jazz to Zymeworks.
verified.dated_milestone: Aug 25, 2026 PDUFA target action date (1L GEA sBLA, priority review); secondary: HERIZON-GEA-01 second interim OS analysis expected mid-2026; BeOne China approval carries a further $15M.
verified.instrument: equity (common, NASDAQ: ZYME); Aug/Sep 2026 calls are the leveraged expression of the dated binary
verified.edge: M — the date and the milestone size are company-disclosed and sell-side-known, and approval odds are high after positive Phase 3 OS (26.4 vs 19.2 months, HR ~0.72) under priority review, so much of the probability is priced. Residual edge is in the balance-sheet mechanics: a non-dilutive $250M inflow into a $1.76B cap on a single dated day, which screens and generalist models under-weight relative to the clinical binary itself.
verified.primary_source: Zymeworks Q1 2026 corporate update / earnings release, GlobeNewswire, May 7, 2026 ("PDUFA target action date of August 25, 2026"; $250M Jazz milestone; $403.8M cash at 3/31/26; $440M total regulatory milestones) — https://www.globenewswire.com/news-release/2026/05/07/3290579/0/en/Zymeworks-Provides-Corporate-Update-and-Reports-First-Quarter-2026-Financial-Results.html
verified.kill_fact: All load-bearing facts survive primary-source check: FDA accepted Jazz's sBLA for Ziihera (zanidatamab-hrii) combinations in 1L HER2+ locally advanced/metastatic GEA under priority review with a PDUFA target action date of Aug 25, 2026 (Jazz PRNewswire release; Zymeworks Q1-2026 8-K/10-Q), and Zymeworks discloses a $250.0M milestone from Jazz on US GEA approval, part of up to $440.0M tied to US/EU/Japan/China GEA approvals. Not fired: as of Jul 20, 2026 no approval or CRL; date is ~5 weeks forward. Price/cap reference is accurate and fresher than claimed — $24.19 / ~$1.73B as of Jul 17, 2026 (71.6M shares), so the $24.11/$1.76B figure is materially correct (call it a July, not June, datapoint). CORRECTIONS: (1) the sBLA is a COMBINATION filing (zanidatamab + tislelizumab/BeOne's TEVIMBRA + chemo as well as chemo-only regimens), not a single-agent 1L filing — a partner-dependent, multi-regimen label adds label-scope risk the line does not price; (2) MATERIAL OMISSION / hidden disqualifier: on Jun 29, 2026 Zymeworks agreed to acquire Theravance Biopharma for $17.00/sh cash (~$929M, plus ampreloxetine CVR), closing expected 2H26. That is roughly 54% of ZYME's own market cap in cash, announced three weeks before this line was written, and it (a) re-purposes the $250M milestone as deal funding rather than incremental optionality, (b) injects a competing, non-catalyst narrative (COPD/YUPELRI diversification, which the sell-side received poorly as a pivot away from oncology), and (c) means post-PDUFA price action will be contaminated by deal-arb/financing flow. (3) Thesis weakness stands and is worse than stated: HERIZON-GEA-01 was positive, priority review was granted, the stock is already ~+84% and 12 analysts sit at Strong Buy / $39 PT — the approval is consensus, so the payoff is asymmetric to the downside on a CRL or narrow label, not a coin-flip binary. Tradeable (NASDAQ, liquid, listed options), but this is a de-risked, partly-priced regulatory date sitting inside an unclosed $929M acquisition — a 7 overstates the edge.
verified.analysis: This clears the gate cleanly: a hard, regulator-set date (Aug 25, 2026, ~5 weeks forward), a named counterparty with a contractual dollar commitment ($250M from Jazz on US GEA approval, part of up to $440M), and a figure material against the ~$1.76B cap — not a macro bet and not yet fired. The main discount is that it is a high-probability rather than a true coin-flip binary: the Phase 3 HERIZON-GEA-01 OS readout was already positive and the sBLA already accepted under priority review, so the equity has partially re-rated and the asymmetry is skewed toward downside on a CRL/label surprise rather than upside on approval. Gap in verification: I did not pull a live intraday quote or current options surface — the $24.11 / $1.76B reference is a June 2026 datapoint, so sizing and any options structure should be re-priced off a fresh quote before acting.
